gloss: Buddha hall; main hall of a Zen temple

definitions.gloss: Buddha hall; main hall of a Zen temple
definitions.explanation: The main building in a Zen Buddhist temple complex that houses the principal Buddha image. The central hall of worship in Zen temple architecture.

examples.japanese: {仏殿|ぶつでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参拝|さんぱい}する→参拝する：15627_sanpaisuru⟧。
examples.english: To worship at the Buddha hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{円覚寺|えんがくじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仏殿|ぶつでん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国宝|こくほう}→国宝：09642_kokuhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Buddha hall of Engaku-ji in Kamakura is designated a National Treasure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{禅宗|ぜんしゅう}→禅宗：14064_zenshuu⟧⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仏殿|ぶつでん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七堂伽藍|しちどうがらん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧し、{本尊|ほんぞん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安置|あんち}→安置：18721_anchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Buddha hall is situated at the center of a Zen temple's seven-hall complex and houses the principal Buddhist image.

notes:
A compound of {仏|ぶつ} (Buddha) and {殿|でん} (hall, palace). Specifically refers to the main worship hall in Zen Buddhist temple architecture. While other Buddhist sects use terms like ⟦{本堂|ほんどう}→本堂：15935_hondou⟧ (main hall) or {金堂|こんどう} (golden hall), {仏殿|ぶつでん} is the term used in Zen temple layouts.

In the traditional Zen temple plan known as {七堂伽藍|しちどうがらん} (seven-hall layout), the {仏殿|ぶつでん} is one of the essential buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏殿|ぶつでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参拝|さんぱい}する→参拝する：15627_sanpaisuru⟧: to visit and worship at the Buddha hall
- {仏殿|ぶつでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建立|こんりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to erect a Buddha hall
- {仏殿|ぶつでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本尊|ほんぞん}: the principal image of the Buddha hall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本堂|ほんどう}→本堂：15935_hondou⟧: main hall — the general term for a temple's main worship hall, used across all Buddhist sects
- {金堂|こんどう}: golden hall — the main hall in older temple styles (Nara, Heian period)
- {法堂|はっとう}: Dharma hall — the hall for sermons and lectures in a Zen temple, distinct from the {仏殿|ぶつでん}
